why: Build My Trip had no dog-friendly dinner spot in Osoyoos besides Backroads Brewing. Only places a published source lists as dog friendly are included; a place that is merely near a dog-friendly spot, or mentioned in one unsure forum comment, is not.

venues.name: Fügassa Italian Eatery
venues.evidence: Watermark Beach Resort's Osoyoos restaurant guide tags it "Dog-friendly patio · Italian eatery · Casual". Listed hours include dinner Friday to Sunday.

notAdded.reason: Named as dog friendly only in the same guide's FAQ, not in its own listing; call to confirm (250.495.4660) before adding.
